response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, n AS employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Employees with NULL ReportsTo form one group, shown with a NULL (blank) ReportsTo. GROUP BY puts NULLs together, so no special handling is needed.
The average share is taken across the groups, with the NULL group included. It equals 1 divided by the number of groups.
Ties in the difference have no defined order.
